title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
summaryZh: 我們要為罪悔改，憑信心接受基督，並勇敢走到台前公開承認祂。
lines: Oh yes, you may be born again at the moment of confirmation, but many of you need to reconfirm your confirmation vows.
沒錯，你可能在堅信禮那一刻重生了，但你們當中許多人需要重新確認你們的堅信禮誓言。
You need to come to the Lord and say, "Lord, I haven't kept those vows."
你需要來到主面前說：「主啊，我沒有遵守那些誓言。」
"I want to re-dedicate my life to what I promised at confirmation, or what was promised for me at baptism."
「我想要將我的生命，重新奉獻給我在堅信禮上所承諾的，或是我受洗時別人為我所承諾的。」
A little Sunday school girl was asked which of the Beatitudes she would rather be like.
有一個主日學的小女孩被問到，她最想成為「八福」中的哪一種人。
She said, "Because I could obtain a pure heart, I would possess all the other good qualities that are spoken of in this chapter."
她說：「因為我若能得著一顆清心，我就會擁有這章聖經裡提到的所有其他美好特質。」
If your heart is right, the rest of you is going to be right too.
如果你的心是對的，你身上的其他部分也都會是對的。
Christ changed the pattern of living.
基督改變了生活的模式。
He said, "A good man out of the good treasures of the heart bringeth forth good things, and an evil man out of the evil treasures brings forth evil things."
祂說：「善人從他心裡所存的善就發出善來；惡人從他所存的惡就發出惡來。」
Christ said, "Except a man is born from above, he cannot see the kingdom of heaven."
基督說：「人若不從上頭生，就不能見神的國。」
First, you must repent of sin.
You have to say to God, "O Lord, I've sinned."
你必須對神說：「主啊，我犯了罪。」
"I'm willing to change my way of living."
Notice, you can't do it yourself.
請注意，你無法靠自己做到。
God has to help you even in the repenting.
甚至在悔改這件事上，神也必須幫助你。
And then you receive Him by faith.
然後你憑著信心接受祂。
When I stepped up on this platform the other night for the first time, I didn't stomp it, check it, to see if it had been built to hold a man.
前幾天晚上我第一次踏上這個講台時，我沒有用力踩它、檢查它，看它是否堅固到能承受一個人的重量。
I had faith in the people that put it here.
我對搭建它的人有信心。
When you sat in that seat, you didn't look it over and feel it to see if it would hold you.
當你坐在那個位子上時，你沒有把椅子仔細檢查、摸一摸，看它能不能撐住你。
You believed in the people that built it.
That's the same kind of faith we're talking about here.
這就是我們在這裡所說的同一種信心。
Not in anything else except Christ, and what He did at the cross, and at the resurrection when God raised Him from the dead and He's alive.
不在於別的，只在於基督，在於祂在十字架上所做的，以及在復活時，神使祂從死裡復活，並且祂現在活著。
I'm going to ask you to do it as we saw last night more than a thousand people do.
我要請你們照做，就像我們昨晚看到的一千多人那樣做。
I'm going to ask you to get up out of your seat.
我要請你們從座位上站起來。
From up there in the top gallery and around, it will take an extra minute or two.
從上面最頂層的樓座和周圍走下來，會多花一兩分鐘的時間。
And all of you down here that God has spoken to, and in the choir.
還有在下面這裡，神已經對你說話的所有人，以及在詩班裡的人。
You may be a leader in the church.
你可能是教會裡的領袖。
Last night we even had a clergyman come.
昨晚我們甚至有一位牧師走到台前。
But you may want to make that commitment.
但你可能想要做出那個承諾。
I'm going to ask you to make that commitment tonight and say, "Lord, I want a new heart."
我要請你們今晚做出那個承諾，並說：「主啊，我要一顆新心。」
"I want to leave here a new person."
「我要成為一個新造的人離開這裡。」
"I want to walk a different road."
Jesus said there are two roads.
There's the narrow road and the broad road.
You're on one or the other.
你不是在這條路上，就是在那條路上。
Young people, older people, whoever you are, I'm going to ask you to come stand here publicly.
年輕人、年長者，無論你是誰，我要請你來到這裡公開地站著。
Why do I do it publicly?
為什麼我要公開地進行呢？
When Jesus died on the cross, He died publicly in your place, and God laid on Him all of our sins.
當耶穌死在十字架上時，祂是公開地代替你死，而且神將我們所有的罪都歸在祂身上。
He said, "If you're not willing to acknowledge Me publicly before men, I'll not acknowledge you before my Father which is in heaven."
祂說：「凡在人面前不肯公開認我的，我在我天上的父面前也必不認他。」
Something about coming and making it public that He requires.
祂要求我們走出來並公開承認，這其中是有意義的。
And it also psychologically does something for you.
而且這在心理上對你也有所幫助。
And then you must follow Him and serve Him.
然後你必須跟從祂並服事祂。
It's not just a one-time experience.
這不只是一次性的經歷。
This is the beginning of something new that's going to be daily with you in which you're trusting Him.
這是某種新事物的開始，它將每天與你同在，在其中你不斷地信靠祂。
You're willing to take up the cross and deny self and follow Him.
你願意背起十字架，捨己，並且跟從祂。
You're willing to look on your neighbors and the needs of the world in a new way.
你願意用一種新的眼光來看待你的鄰舍和這世界的需要。
I'm going to ask you to get up and come right now.
我現在就要請你們站起來，走到台前。
And after you've all come, I'm going to say a word to you, and have a prayer with you, and give you some literature to help you in your Christian life.
當你們都來到台前之後，我會對你們說幾句話，並為你們代禱，也會給你們一些文字資料，來幫助你們的基督徒生活。
And if you're with your friends or relatives, or you've come in a group, they'll wait, but you get up and come.
如果你和朋友或親戚在一起，或者你們是結伴而來的，他們會等你的，只要你站起來，走到台前。
We're only going to keep you a few moments here.
我們只會讓你們在這裡留步片刻。
Just get up and come right now.
現在就站起來，走到台前。
Hundreds of you that God has spoken to.
神已經對你們數百人說了話。
There's a little voice inside that says you ought to come.
裡面有一個微小的聲音說你應該過來。
From here, up there, and in the choir.
從這裡、從上面，以及在詩班裡。
God has spoken to some of you.
神已經對你們當中的一些人說話了。
